parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s.name IN ['Westminster','Waterloo'] OR s.display_name IN ['Westminster','Waterloo'] RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id

OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)

    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {name: n.name},

parameters.query:
MATCH (source:UndergroundStation)
WHERE source.name IN ['Westminster','Waterloo']
MATCH (target:UndergroundStation)
WHERE target <> source
MATCH p = shortestPath((source)-[:LINK*]-(target))
WITH source.name AS station, sum(1.0 / length(p)) AS harmonicSum, count(target) AS reachable
RETURN station, harmonicSum / 301 AS normalizedScore, harmonicSum, reachable
ORDER BY station

raw_results.question: I want to run closeness centrality with the Wasserman-Faust formula and get scores for stations Westminster and Waterloo. Answer format should be as Station: score.Separate the stations' result with a comma.

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s.name IN ['Westminster','Waterloo'] RETURN s.name AS name, s.id AS id, s.display_name AS display_name

MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
WHERE s.name IN ['Westminster','Waterloo']
MATCH (t:UndergroundStation)
WHERE t <> s
OPTIONAL MATCH p = shortestPath((s)-[:LINK*]-(t))
WITH s.name AS station, count(t) AS totalOther, count(p) AS reachable, sum(length(p)) AS sumDistances
RETURN station, totalOther, reachable, sumDistances,
       CASE WHEN sumDistances = 0 OR sumDistances IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE (toFloat(reachable) / totalOther) * (toFloat(reachable) / sumDistances) END AS wfCloseness
ORDER BY station

parameters.query:
MATCH (v:UndergroundStation) WHERE v.name IN ['Westminster','Waterloo']
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
MATCH (t:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(s) <> id(t) AND id(s) <> id(v) AND id(t) <> id(v)
CALL {
  WITH s,t
  MATCH p = allShortestPaths((s)-[:LINK*]->(t))
  RETURN collect(p) AS paths
}
WITH v, s, t, paths, size(paths) AS totalPaths
WHERE totalPaths > 0
WITH v, sum(toFloat(size([p IN paths WHERE v IN nodes(p)])) / totalPaths) AS score
RETURN v.name AS station, score
ORDER BY station

MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
WITH s LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
RETURN count(n) AS total,
       count { WITH s, n MATCH (s)-[:LINK*0..]->(n) } AS reachableFromS,
       count { WITH s, n MATCH (n)-[:LINK*0..]->(s) } AS canReachS

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE NOT (b)-[:LINK]->(a)
RETURN count(r) AS nonReciprocalLinks

raw_results.question: Execute k-core decomposition and obtain the core value for the Stockwell station. Reply strictly with Stockwell:answer and do not output anything else.

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name:'Stockwell'})-[r:LINK]-(nbr:UndergroundStation)
RETURN s.name AS station, count(r) AS incidentLinks, collect({neighbor:nbr.name, line:r.line, dir:startNode(r).name + '->' + endNode(r).name}) AS links

MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
WITH collect(elementId(n)) AS allNodes
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WITH allNodes, collect([elementId(a), elementId(b)]) AS rels
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name:'Stockwell'})
WITH allNodes, rels, elementId(s) AS stockwellId
UNWIND [4,5] AS k
WITH k, stockwellId,
     reduce(alive = allNodes, iter IN range(1, size(allNodes)) |
       [x IN alive WHERE size([rel IN rels WHERE ((rel[0] = x AND rel[1] IN alive) OR (rel[1] = x AND rel[0] IN alive))]) >= k]
     ) AS coreNodes
RETURN k, stockwellId IN coreNodes AS stockwellInKCore, size(coreNodes) AS coreSize
ORDER BY k

raw_results.question: I want to know the community modularity scores using community property rail. Reply only with community:score and nothing else. If the community is a number, write it as text e.g., 0 --> zero.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {rail: toInteger(n.rail)},
    targetNodeProperties: {rail: toInteger(m.rail)},
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  {undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK']}
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
WITH n.rail AS rail, count(*) AS nodes
MATCH (:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(:UndergroundStation)
WITH collect({rail: rail, nodes: nodes}) AS communities, count(r) AS rels
UNWIND communities AS c
RETURN c.rail AS rail, c.nodes AS nodes, rels
ORDER BY rail

MATCH ()-[r:LINK]->() WITH count(r) AS totalR
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
WITH totalR, collect(DISTINCT n.rail) AS rails
UNWIND rails AS rail
CALL {
  WITH rail
  MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
  WHERE a.rail = rail AND b.rail = rail
  RETURN count(r) AS intraDirected
}
CALL {
  WITH rail
  MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
  WHERE n.rail = rail
  OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]-()
  RETURN count(r) AS degreeVolumeUndirectedDB
}
RETURN rail, totalR, intraDirected, degreeVolumeUndirectedDB
ORDER BY rail

raw_results.question: I want to know the community conductance scores using community property rail. Reply only with community:score and nothing else. If the community is a number, write it as text e.g., 0 --> zero.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {rail: toInteger(n.rail)},
    targetNodeProperties: {rail: toInteger(m.rail)},
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
WITH collect({a: toInteger(n.rail), b: toInteger(m.rail)}) AS rels
UNWIND [0,1] AS c
WITH c, rels
UNWIND rels AS rel
WITH c,
     sum(CASE WHEN rel.a = c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN rel.b = c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total,
     sum(CASE WHEN rel.a = c AND rel.b <> c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN rel.b = c AND rel.a <> c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS external
RETURN c AS community, external * 1.0 / total AS conductance, external, total
ORDER BY community

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: { rail: toInteger(n.rail) },
    targetNodeProperties: { rail: toInteger(m.rail) },
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:UndergroundStation {name:'Kennington'})-[r:LINK]-(n:UndergroundStation)
RETURN k.name AS station, k.rail AS stationRail, collect(DISTINCT {neighbor:n.name, rail:n.rail}) AS neighbors, count(DISTINCT n) AS degree,

       sum(CASE WHEN n.rail=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rail1Neighbors

raw_results.question: I want to run node similarity and find the eight most similar station pairs using cosine similarity. Return each pair in the following format "station1 station2: similarity". Do not return anything else.

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:LINK]-(nbr:UndergroundStation)
WITH s, collect(DISTINCT nbr.name) AS nbrs
WITH collect({name:s.name, nbrs:nbrs, deg:size(nbrs)}) AS stations
UNWIND range(0, size(stations)-2) AS i
UNWIND range(i+1, size(stations)-1) AS j
WITH stations[i] AS a, stations[j] AS b
WITH a, b, size([x IN a.nbrs WHERE x IN b.nbrs]) AS inter
WHERE a.deg > 0 AND b.deg > 0 AND inter > 0
WITH a.name AS station1, b.name AS station2, toFloat(inter) / sqrt(toFloat(a.deg * b.deg)) AS similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC, station1 ASC, station2 ASC
LIMIT 20
RETURN station1, station2, similarity

CALL gds.nodeSimilarity.stream('station_similarity_graph', {similarityMetric: 'COSINE'})
YIELD node1, node2, similarity
WITH gds.util.asNode(node1).name AS a, gds.util.asNode(node2).name AS b, similarity
WITH CASE WHEN a < b THEN a ELSE b END AS station1,
     CASE WHEN a < b THEN b ELSE a END AS station2,
     similarity
WITH station1, station2, max(similarity) AS similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC, station1 ASC, station2 ASC
LIMIT 8
RETURN station1, station2, similarity

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name:'Sloane Square'})-[:LINK]->(sn:UndergroundStation)
WITH collect(DISTINCT sn.name) AS sNeighbors
MATCH (c:UndergroundStation)
WHERE c.name IN ['Knightsbridge','Acton Town','Green Park','Pimlico']
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:LINK]->(cn:UndergroundStation)
WITH c.name AS station, sNeighbors, collect(DISTINCT cn.name) AS cNeighbors
WITH station, size([x IN sNeighbors WHERE x IN cNeighbors]) AS inter, size(sNeighbors + [x IN cNeighbors WHERE NOT x IN sNeighbors]) AS unionSize
RETURN station, toFloat(inter)/unionSize AS similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC, station

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)

  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),

    relationshipProperties: {time: toFloat(r.time)}

parameters.query:
MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: 'Covent Garden'})
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.delta.stream('covent_delta_time_graph', {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty: 'time', delta: 50.0})
YIELD targetNode, totalCost, nodeIds, costs
WITH [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, costs, totalCost
RETURN count(*) AS rows, min(totalCost) AS minCost, max(totalCost) AS maxCost, collect(CASE WHEN path = ['Covent Garden'] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sourceFlags

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name:'Covent Garden'})
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.delta.stream('covent_delta_time_graph', {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty: 'time', delta: 50.0})

raw_results.question: Please run the Dijkstra shortest path algorithm from Barons Court to South Kensington. I want the answer to be in the format of the path and the costs. For example, ["Barons Court", "X", "Y", "South Kensington"]: [0.0, 3.0, 4.5, 9.9].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s.name IN ['Barons Court','South Kensington'] RETURN s.name AS name, s.id AS id, s.display_name AS display_name

MATCH p=(a:UndergroundStation {name:'Barons Court'})-[r:LINK*1..5]->(b:UndergroundStation {name:'South Kensington'})
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS path, [rel IN relationships(p) | rel.time] AS times, [rel IN relationships(p) | rel.distance] AS distances, reduce(t=0, rel IN relationships(p) | t + rel.time) AS totalTime, reduce(d=0, rel IN relationships(p) | d + rel.distance) AS totalDistance
ORDER BY totalTime ASC, totalDistance ASC LIMIT 10

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {name: n.name},
    targetNodeProperties: {name: m.name},
    relationshipType: type(r),
    relationshipProperties: {time: toFloat(r.time), distance: toFloat(r.distance)}
  }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH p=(a:UndergroundStation {name:'Barons Court'})-[:LINK*1..5]->(b:UndergroundStation {name:'South Kensington'})
WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE single(m IN nodes(p) WHERE m = n))
WITH p, reduce(t=0, rel IN relationships(p) | t + rel.time) AS totalTime
RETURN min(totalTime) AS minTimeUnderOrEqual5Hops,
       count { WITH p, totalTime WHERE totalTime < 6 RETURN 1 } AS pathsBelow6,
       [n IN nodes(head(collect(p))) | n.name] AS oneMinPath
ORDER BY minTimeUnderOrEqual5Hops LIMIT 1
MATCH ()-[r:LINK]->() RETURN min(r.time) AS minTime, min(r.distance) AS minDistance, count(r) AS relationships

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $source})
CALL gds.shortestPath.dijkstra.stream($graphName, {
  sourceNode: source,
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance'
})
YIELD targetNode, totalCost, nodeIds, costs
RETURN [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, costs
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, last(path) ASC

  sourceNode: source,
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance'
})
YIELD sourceNode, targetNode, totalCost, nodeIds, costs
WHERE sourceNode = id(source)
RETURN [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, costs
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, last(path) ASC

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $source})
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream($graphName, {relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance'})
YIELD sourceNode, targetNode, totalCost, nodeIds, costs
WHERE sourceNode = id(source)
WITH [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, costs, totalCost
WITH path, costs, totalCost,
     '[' + reduce(s = '', x IN path | s + CASE WHEN s = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + '"' + replace(x, '"', '\\"') + '"') + ']' AS pathStr,

RETURN pathStr + ': ' + costsStr AS result
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, last(path) ASC

RETURN pathStr + ': ' + costsStr AS result

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $source})

YIELD nodeIds, costs, totalCost
WITH [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, costs, totalCost
RETURN count(*) AS count, min(totalCost) AS minCost, max(totalCost) AS maxCost

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $source})
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream($graphName, {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance'})
YIELD nodeIds, costs, totalCost
WITH [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path, costs, totalCost
WITH path, costs, totalCost, size(path) AS n
RETURN last(path) AS target, totalCost AS cost, CASE WHEN n=1 THEN null ELSE path[n-2] END AS predecessor, CASE WHEN n=1 THEN null ELSE costs[n-2] END AS predecessorCost, n AS hopsPlusOne
ORDER BY totalCost, target

raw_results.question: Find the 3 shortest paths from Bank to Waterloo using the Yen's algorithm using time as the relationship weight. Format the results as path: costs, for example, ["A", "B", "C"]: [0.0, 98.7, 100.1], ["A", "E", "C"]: [0.0, 32.5, 150.0].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s.name IN ['Bank','Waterloo'] RETURN s.name AS name, s.id AS id, s.display_name AS display_name

MATCH p = (src:UndergroundStation {name: 'Bank'})-[:LINK*1..9]->(dst:UndergroundStation {name: 'Waterloo'})
WITH p, nodes(p) AS ns, relationships(p) AS rs
WHERE size(ns) = size(apoc.coll.toSet(ns))
WITH [n IN ns | n.name] AS path,
     reduce(total = 0.0, r IN rs | total + toFloat(r.time)) AS totalCost,
     reduce(costs = [0.0], r IN rs | costs + [last(costs) + toFloat(r.time)]) AS costs
RETURN path, costs, totalCost
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, size(path) ASC, path ASC
LIMIT 5

MATCH p = (src:UndergroundStation {name: 'Bank'})-[:LINK*1..9]->(dst:UndergroundStation {name: 'Waterloo'})
WITH p, nodes(p) AS ns, relationships(p) AS rs
WHERE all(x IN ns WHERE single(y IN ns WHERE elementId(y) = elementId(x)))
WITH [n IN ns | n.name] AS path,
     reduce(total = 0.0, r IN rs | total + toFloat(r.time)) AS totalCost,
     reduce(costs = [0.0], r IN rs | costs + [last(costs) + toFloat(r.time)]) AS costs
RETURN path, costs, totalCost
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, size(path) ASC, path ASC
LIMIT 5

raw_results.question: I would like to find the minimum weighted spanning tree rooted at Hammersmith using time as the relationship weight. I want the output to be in the format of a sequence of [node, parent, weight]. For example: ["A", "B", 2.0], ["A", "C", 3.0], ["K", "L", 9.5].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'hammersmith' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'hammersmith' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id ORDER BY name

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $sourceName})
CALL gds.spanningTree.stream($graphName, {
  sourceNode: source,
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'
})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name AS node,
       gds.util.asNode(parentId).name AS parent,
       toFloat(weight) AS weight
ORDER BY node

SHOW PROCEDURES YIELD name
WHERE name STARTS WITH 'apoc.'
RETURN collect(name)[0..20] AS apocProcedures, count(*) AS count

MATCH (root:UndergroundStation {name:$sourceName})
CALL {
  WITH root
  CALL gds.spanningTree.stream($graphName, {sourceNode: root, relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
  YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
  WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId) AS n, gds.util.asNode(parentId) AS p, toFloat(weight) AS w
  WHERE id(n) <> id(p)
  RETURN collect({a: id(n), b: id(p), weight: w, key: CASE WHEN id(n) < id(p) THEN id(n)+'|'+id(p) ELSE id(p)+'|'+id(n) END}) AS treeEdges,
         collect(CASE WHEN id(n) < id(p) THEN id(n)+'|'+id(p) ELSE id(p)+'|'+id(n) END) AS treeKeys,
         count(*) AS treeEdgeCount,
         sum(w) AS treeWeight
}
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
WITH root, treeEdges, treeKeys, treeEdgeCount, treeWeight, count(s) AS stationCount
CALL {
  MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]-(b:UndergroundStation)
  WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  RETURN count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN id(a) < id(b) THEN id(a)+'|'+id(b) ELSE id(b)+'|'+id(a) END) AS undirectedEdgeCount
}
CALL {
  WITH treeEdges, treeKeys
  UNWIND treeEdges AS te
  MATCH (a:UndergroundStation) WHERE id(a)=te.a
  MATCH (b:UndergroundStation) WHERE id(b)=te.b
  MATCH (a)-[r:LINK]-(b)
  WITH te, min(toFloat(r.time)) AS dbMinTime
  RETURN count(*) AS treeEdgesChecked,
         sum(CASE WHEN dbMinTime = te.weight THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS badTreeEdgeWeights
}
CALL {
  WITH treeEdges
  UNWIND treeEdges AS te
  MATCH (a:UndergroundStation) WHERE id(a)=te.a
  MATCH (b:UndergroundStation) WHERE id(b)=te.b
  MERGE (a)-[:_TEMP_MST_VERIFY {weight: te.weight}]->(b)
  RETURN count(*) AS tempCreated
}
CALL {
  WITH treeKeys
  MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]-(b:UndergroundStation)
  WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  WITH a,b,min(toFloat(r.time)) AS edgeWeight, CASE WHEN id(a) < id(b) THEN id(a)+'|'+id(b) ELSE id(b)+'|'+id(a) END AS key, treeKeys
  WHERE NOT key IN treeKeys
  MATCH p = (a)-[:_TEMP_MST_VERIFY*]-(b)
  WITH edgeWeight, [rel IN relationships(p) | rel.weight] AS pathWeights
  RETURN count(*) AS nonTreeEdgesChecked,
         sum(CASE WHEN reduce(mx=0.0, x IN pathWeights | CASE WHEN x > mx THEN x ELSE mx END) <= edgeWeight THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS cyclePropertyViolations
}
MATCH (:UndergroundStation)-[tmp:_TEMP_MST_VERIFY]->(:UndergroundStation)
DELETE tmp
RETURN stationCount, treeEdgeCount, treeWeight, undirectedEdgeCount, treeEdgesChecked, badTreeEdgeWeights, nonTreeEdgesChecked, cyclePropertyViolations

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $sourceName})
CALL gds.spanningTree.stream($graphName, {
  sourceNode: source,
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'
})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name AS node,
     gds.util.asNode(parentId).name AS parent,
     toFloat(weight) AS weight
WHERE node <> parent
RETURN collect([node, parent, weight]) AS mst
ORDER BY size(mst)

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $sourceName})
CALL gds.spanningTree.stream($graphName, {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name AS node, gds.util.asNode(parentId).name AS parent, toFloat(weight) AS weight
RETURN count(*) AS rowsIncludingRoot, count(CASE WHEN node<>parent THEN 1 END) AS edgeCount, sum(CASE WHEN node<>parent THEN weight ELSE 0.0 END) AS totalWeight, collect(CASE WHEN node=parent THEN node END) AS rootRows

raw_results.question: Find the minimum directed steiner tree from Bank to Waterloo, Southwark and Westminster. I want the output to be in the format of a sequence of [node, parent, weight]. For example: ["A", "B", 2.0], ["A", "C", 3.0], ["K", "L", 9.5].

parameters.query: MATCH (n:UndergroundStation) WHERE n.name IN ['Bank','Waterloo','Southwark','Westminster'] RETURN n.name AS name, n.id AS id, n.display_name AS display_name ORDER BY name

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE (a.name='Bank' AND b.name='Waterloo') OR (a.name='Waterloo' AND b.name IN ['Westminster','Southwark'])
RETURN a.name AS parent, b.name AS node, r.distance AS distance, r.time AS time, r.line AS line
ORDER BY parent,node,line

MATCH p=(s:UndergroundStation {name:'Bank'})-[:LINK*1..6]->(t:UndergroundStation)
WHERE t.name IN ['Waterloo','Southwark','Westminster']
  AND all(i IN range(0, size(nodes(p))-1) WHERE single(n IN nodes(p) WHERE id(n)=id(nodes(p)[i])))
WITH [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS path, reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(p) | w + r.distance) AS totalDistance, t.name AS target
WHERE totalDistance <= 6
RETURN target, totalDistance, path
ORDER BY target, totalDistance, size(path), path
LIMIT 50

MATCH pWm=(s:UndergroundStation {name:'Bank'})-[:LINK*1..6]->(:UndergroundStation {name:'Westminster'})
WHERE all(i IN range(0, size(nodes(pWm))-1) WHERE single(n IN nodes(pWm) WHERE id(n)=id(nodes(pWm)[i])))
WITH pWm, reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(pWm) | w + r.distance) AS dWm
WHERE dWm <= 6
MATCH pWa=(s)-[:LINK*1..6]->(:UndergroundStation {name:'Waterloo'})
WHERE all(i IN range(0, size(nodes(pWa))-1) WHERE single(n IN nodes(pWa) WHERE id(n)=id(nodes(pWa)[i])))
WITH pWm, dWm, pWa, reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(pWa) | w + r.distance) AS dWa
WHERE dWa <= 6
MATCH pS=(s)-[:LINK*1..6]->(:UndergroundStation {name:'Southwark'})
WHERE all(i IN range(0, size(nodes(pS))-1) WHERE single(n IN nodes(pS) WHERE id(n)=id(nodes(pS)[i])))
WITH pWm, pWa, pS, dWm, dWa, reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(pS) | w + r.distance) AS dS
WHERE dS <= 6
WITH [r IN relationships(pWm) | id(r)] + [r IN relationships(pWa) | id(r)] + [r IN relationships(pS) | id(r)] AS relIds,
     [n IN nodes(pWm) | n.name] AS pathWestminster,
     [n IN nodes(pWa) | n.name] AS pathWaterloo,
     [n IN nodes(pS) | n.name] AS pathSouthwark
UNWIND relIds AS rid
WITH collect(DISTINCT rid) AS distinctRelIds, pathWestminster, pathWaterloo, pathSouthwark
MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE id(r) IN distinctRelIds
WITH sum(r.distance) AS unionWeight, pathWestminster, pathWaterloo, pathSouthwark
RETURN unionWeight, pathWaterloo, pathSouthwark, pathWestminster
ORDER BY unionWeight
LIMIT 10

MATCH (root:UndergroundStation {name:'Bank'})
MATCH pWm=(root)-[:LINK*1..6]->(:UndergroundStation {name:'Westminster'})
WHERE all(i IN range(0, size(nodes(pWm))-1) WHERE single(n IN nodes(pWm) WHERE id(n)=id(nodes(pWm)[i])))
WITH root, pWm, reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(pWm) | w + r.distance) AS dWm
WHERE dWm <= 6
MATCH pWa=(root)-[:LINK*1..6]->(:UndergroundStation {name:'Waterloo'})
WHERE all(i IN range(0, size(nodes(pWa))-1) WHERE single(n IN nodes(pWa) WHERE id(n)=id(nodes(pWa)[i])))
WITH root, pWm, dWm, pWa, reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(pWa) | w + r.distance) AS dWa
WHERE dWa <= 6
MATCH pS=(root)-[:LINK*1..6]->(:UndergroundStation {name:'Southwark'})
WHERE all(i IN range(0, size(nodes(pS))-1) WHERE single(n IN nodes(pS) WHERE id(n)=id(nodes(pS)[i])))
WITH pWm, pWa, pS, dWm, dWa, reduce(w=0, r IN relationships(pS) | w + r.distance) AS dS
WHERE dS <= 6
WITH [r IN relationships(pWm) | id(r)] + [r IN relationships(pWa) | id(r)] + [r IN relationships(pS) | id(r)] AS relIds,
     [n IN nodes(pWm) | n.name] AS pathWestminster,
     [n IN nodes(pWa) | n.name] AS pathWaterloo,
     [n IN nodes(pS) | n.name] AS pathSouthwark
UNWIND relIds AS rid
WITH collect(DISTINCT rid) AS distinctRelIds, pathWestminster, pathWaterloo, pathSouthwark
MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE id(r) IN distinctRelIds
WITH sum(r.distance) AS unionWeight, pathWestminster, pathWaterloo, pathSouthwark
RETURN unionWeight, pathWaterloo, pathSouthwark, pathWestminster
ORDER BY unionWeight
LIMIT 10

raw_results.question: Compute the prize collecting Steiner tree on my graph in the database with distance as the relationship weight and zone as the node prize. Format the results as a sequence of [node, parent, weight]. For example: ["A", "B", 2.0], ["A", "C", 3.0], ["K", "L", 9.5].

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {zone: toFloat(n.zone)},
    targetNodeProperties: {zone: toFloat(m.zone)},
    relationshipType: type(r),
    relationshipProperties: {distance: toFloat(r.distance)}
  }
)

parameters.query:
CALL gds.prizeSteinerTree.stream('pcst_zone_distance_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance', prizeProperty: 'zone'})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name AS node, gds.util.asNode(parentId).name AS parent, weight
RETURN collect([node, parent, toFloat(weight)]) AS triples, count(*) AS edgeCount, sum(weight) AS totalWeight

CALL gds.prizeSteinerTree.stream('pcst_zone_distance_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance', prizeProperty: 'zone'})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
WITH collect({node: gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name, parent: gds.util.asNode(parentId).name, weight: toInteger(weight)}) AS edges, sum(weight) AS algTotal, count(*) AS edgeCount
UNWIND edges AS e
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation {name: e.node}), (p:UndergroundStation {name: e.parent})
WITH edges, algTotal, edgeCount, e, EXISTS { MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]-(p) WHERE r.distance = e.weight } AS existsWithWeight
WITH edges, algTotal, edgeCount, count(CASE WHEN existsWithWeight THEN 1 END) AS verifiedEdges,
     collect(e.node) + collect(e.parent) AS endpoints
UNWIND endpoints AS endpoint
WITH algTotal, edgeCount, verifiedEdges, count(DISTINCT endpoint) AS distinctNodesInTree
RETURN edgeCount, distinctNodesInTree, edgeCount = distinctNodesInTree - 1 AS edgeNodeTreeCountCheck,
       algTotal AS totalWeight, verifiedEdges, verifiedEdges = edgeCount AS allEdgesExistWithDistance

parameters.query:

ORDER BY depth, target

  sourceNode: source,

})

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name: $sourceName})
CALL gds.bellmanFord.stream($graphName, {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty:'time'})
YIELD targetNode, totalCost
WITH collect({targetNode: targetNode, bfCost: totalCost}) AS bfRows, source

YIELD totalCost
WITH count(*) AS checked, sum(CASE WHEN abs(totalCost - row.bfCost) < 0.000001 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS mismatches
RETURN checked, mismatches

MATCH (:UndergroundStation {name:$name})-[r:LINK]-(:UndergroundStation) RETURN type(r) AS type, r.line AS line, r.distance AS distance, r.time AS time LIMIT 10

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)

MATCH (b)-[rr:LINK]->(a)

parameters.query:
MATCH (target:UndergroundStation {name:'Notting Hill Gate'})
MATCH (x:UndergroundStation)
CALL {
  WITH x, target
  WITH x, target WHERE x = target
  RETURN 0 AS d
  UNION
  WITH x, target
  WITH x, target WHERE x <> target
  MATCH p = shortestPath((x)-[:LINK*]-(target))
  RETURN length(p) AS d
}
WITH target, collect({nid: id(x), d: d}) AS ds
MATCH path = (source:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK*1..30]->(target)
WHERE all(i IN range(0, length(path)-1) WHERE
  single(a IN ds WHERE a.nid = id(nodes(path)[i]) AND
    single(b IN ds WHERE b.nid = id(nodes(path)[i+1]) AND a.d > b.d)))
WITH path, reduce(total = 0.0, rel IN relationships(path) | total + toFloat(rel.distance)) AS total
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.name] AS path, total
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 3

raw_results.question: Could you help me find out what are the few quickest ways to go from Paddington to London Bridge? Format the results as path: costs, for example, ["A", "B", "C"]: [0.0, 98.7, 100.1], ["A", "E", "C"]: [0.0, 32.5, 150.0].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'paddington' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'paddington' OR toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'london bridge' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'london bridge' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id ORDER BY name

MATCH p=(src:UndergroundStation {name:'Paddington'})-[:LINK*..10]-(dst:UndergroundStation {name:'London Bridge'})
WHERE all(i IN range(0, size(nodes(p))-1) WHERE single(n IN nodes(p) WHERE id(n)=id(nodes(p)[i])))
WITH [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS path, reduce(total=0.0, r IN relationships(p) | total + toFloat(r.time)) AS totalCost
WITH path, min(totalCost) AS totalCost
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, size(path) ASC, path ASC
RETURN path, totalCost
LIMIT 8

raw_results.question: I would like to find out whether King's Cross St. Pancras or Angel is a more important station. My definition of a station being important is that it should lie on many shortest paths for any two stations. Tell me the station that is the answer and nothing else.

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'king' OR toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'angel' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id ORDER BY name

MATCH (candidate:UndergroundStation)
WHERE candidate.name IN ["King's Cross St. Pancras", "Angel"]
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation), (b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(a) < id(b) AND a <> candidate AND b <> candidate
MATCH p = allShortestPaths((a)-[:LINK*]-(b))
WITH candidate, p
WHERE candidate IN nodes(p)[1..-1]
RETURN candidate.name AS station, count(p) AS shortest_paths_through_station
ORDER BY shortest_paths_through_station DESC

MATCH (candidate:UndergroundStation)
WHERE candidate.name IN ["King's Cross St. Pancras", "Angel"]
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation), (b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(a) < id(b) AND a <> candidate AND b <> candidate
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:LINK*]-(b))
WITH candidate, p
WHERE candidate IN nodes(p)[1..-1]
RETURN candidate.name AS station, count(p) AS one_shortest_path_pairs_through_station
ORDER BY one_shortest_path_pairs_through_station DESC

raw_results.question: What are the stations that, when closed, will create more stations that one can not go from one to the other? List such stops in the format of ["A", "B", "C"].

parameters.query:
MATCH (v:UndergroundStation)--(nbr:UndergroundStation)
WITH v, collect(DISTINCT nbr) AS neighbors
WHERE size(neighbors) > 1
WITH v, neighbors[0] AS firstNeighbor, neighbors[1..] AS otherNeighbors
WHERE any(n IN otherNeighbors WHERE NOT EXISTS {
  MATCH p = (firstNeighbor)-[:LINK*]-(n)
  WHERE none(x IN nodes(p) WHERE x = v)
})
RETURN v.name AS station
ORDER BY station

raw_results.question: Which 5 stations are geographically closest to Paddington? List the station names in the format ["A", "B", "C"].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'paddington' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'paddington' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.latitude AS lat, s.longitude AS lon

MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name:'Paddington'})
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
WHERE s <> p
WITH s, point.distance(point({latitude:p.latitude, longitude:p.longitude}), point({latitude:s.latitude, longitude:s.longitude})) AS meters
RETURN s.name AS name, meters
ORDER BY meters ASC
LIMIT 10

MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name:'Paddington'})
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
WHERE s <> p
WITH s,
     radians(s.latitude - p.latitude) AS dLat,
     radians(s.longitude - p.longitude) AS dLon,
     radians(p.latitude) AS lat1,
     radians(s.latitude) AS lat2
WITH s, 2 * 6371000 * asin(sqrt(sin(dLat/2)^2 + cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(dLon/2)^2)) AS meters
RETURN s.name AS name, meters
ORDER BY meters ASC
LIMIT 5

MATCH (all:UndergroundStation)

MATCH p=(start)-[:LINK*0..]-(n:UndergroundStation)

parameters.query:
MATCH (orig:UndergroundStation)
WITH collect(orig) AS nodes
UNWIND nodes AS removed
WITH removed, [n IN nodes WHERE id(n) <> id(removed)] AS remNodes
UNWIND remNodes AS candidate
WITH removed, remNodes, candidate
WHERE NOT EXISTS {
  UNWIND remNodes AS other
  WITH other
  WHERE id(other) < id(candidate)
  MATCH p = (candidate)-[:LINK*]-(other)
  WHERE none(x IN nodes(p) WHERE id(x) = id(removed))
}
WITH removed, count(candidate) AS componentsAfterRemoval
WITH count(CASE WHEN componentsAfterRemoval > 1 THEN 1 END) AS articulationPointCount
RETURN articulationPointCount

raw_results.question: Run harmonic centrality and provide the centrality scores for Westminster and Waterloo stations. Answer should be given as Station: score.

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) IN ['westminster','waterloo'] RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation)
WHERE source.name IN ['Westminster','Waterloo']
MATCH (target:UndergroundStation)
WHERE target <> source
MATCH p = shortestPath((source)-[:LINK*]-(target))
WITH source.name AS station, count(target) AS reachable, sum(1.0 / length(p)) AS harmonicSum, count { MATCH (:UndergroundStation) } AS totalStations
RETURN station, reachable, harmonicSum, harmonicSum / (totalStations - 1) AS normalizedScore
ORDER BY station

parameters.cypher_query:

OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)

  }
)

MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,

    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN [] ELSE labels(m) END,
    relationshipType: CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE type(r) END

parameters.query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
WITH count(n) AS total
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
WHERE s.name IN ['Westminster', 'Waterloo']
CALL {
  WITH s
  MATCH (t:UndergroundStation)
  WHERE t <> s
  OPTIONAL MATCH p = shortestPath((s)-[:LINK*]->(t))
  RETURN count(p) AS reachable, sum(length(p)) AS totalDistance
}
RETURN s.name AS station, reachable, totalDistance,
       (toFloat(reachable) / (total - 1)) * (toFloat(reachable) / totalDistance) AS wfCloseness
ORDER BY station

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation), (t:UndergroundStation)
WHERE s <> t
MATCH p = allShortestPaths((s)-[:LINK*]->(t))
WITH s, t, collect(p) AS paths
WITH s, t, paths, size(paths) AS total
UNWIND ['Waterloo','Westminster'] AS station
MATCH (v:UndergroundStation {name: station})
WHERE v <> s AND v <> t
WITH station, total, size([p IN paths WHERE v IN nodes(p)]) AS through
RETURN station, sum(toFloat(through) / total) AS score
ORDER BY station

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,

  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    relationshipType: type(r)
  }
)

MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]-(m:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(n) < id(m)
WITH DISTINCT n, m
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    relationshipType: 'LINK'
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (u:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]-(v:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(u) < id(v)
WITH DISTINCT u, v
WHERE NOT EXISTS {
  MATCH p = (u)-[:LINK*]-(v)
  WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE NOT (startNode(r) IN [u, v] AND endNode(r) IN [u, v]))
}
RETURN count(*) AS bridgeCount

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    relationshipType: type(r)
  }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(:UndergroundStation)
WITH count(r) AS total
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE (b)-[:LINK]->(a)
RETURN total, count(*) AS relsWithReverse

raw_results.question: Determine the number of strongly connected components in my graph. Reply only with scc:answer and nothing else.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN [] ELSE labels(m) END,
    relationshipType: CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN null ELSE type(r) END
  }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (start:UndergroundStation)
WITH start LIMIT 1
CALL {
  WITH start
  MATCH (start)-[:LINK*0..]->(r:UndergroundStation)
  RETURN count(DISTINCT r) AS reachableFromStart
}
CALL {
  WITH start
  MATCH (r:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK*0..]->(start)
  RETURN count(DISTINCT r) AS canReachStart
}
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
RETURN count(n) AS totalNodes, reachableFromStart, canReachStart

raw_results.question: Run k-core decomposition and return the core value for Stockwell station. Reply strictly with Stockwell:answer and do not output anything else.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {name: n.name},
    targetNodeProperties: {name: m.name},
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
WITH collect(n.name) AS nodes
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WITH nodes, collect([a.name, b.name]) AS edges
WITH nodes, edges,
  reduce(alive = nodes, i IN range(1, size(nodes)) |
    [v IN alive WHERE size([e IN edges WHERE ((e[0] = v AND e[1] IN alive) OR (e[1] = v AND e[0] IN alive))]) >= 4]
  ) AS core4,
  reduce(alive = nodes, i IN range(1, size(nodes)) |
    [v IN alive WHERE size([e IN edges WHERE ((e[0] = v AND e[1] IN alive) OR (e[1] = v AND e[0] IN alive))]) >= 5]
  ) AS core5
RETURN 'Stockwell' IN core4 AS in4Core, 'Stockwell' IN core5 AS in5Core, size(core4) AS core4Size, size(core5) AS core5Size

raw_results.question: Compute the communities’ modularity scores using the rail community property. Reply only with community:score and nothing else. If the community is a number, write it as text e.g., 0 --> zero.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {rail: toInteger(n.rail)},
    targetNodeProperties: {rail: toInteger(m.rail)},
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(:UndergroundStation)
WITH count(r) AS origRels
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
WITH origRels, collect(n) AS nodes
UNWIND [0,1] AS c
WITH c, origRels, [n IN nodes WHERE n.rail = c] AS commNodes
UNWIND commNodes AS n
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]-(:UndergroundStation)
WITH c, origRels, count(r) AS degreeSum
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation {rail:c})-[ir:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation {rail:c})
WITH c, origRels, degreeSum, count(ir) AS internalOrigDirected
RETURN c AS community, origRels, degreeSum, internalOrigDirected,
       (toFloat(internalOrigDirected) / origRels) - (toFloat(degreeSum) / (2*origRels))^2 AS modularityContribution
ORDER BY community

raw_results.question: Compute the communities’ conductance scores using the rail community property. Reply only with community:score and nothing else. If the community is a number, write it as text e.g., 0 --> zero.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN [] ELSE labels(m) END,
    sourceNodeProperties: {rail: toInteger(n.rail)},
    targetNodeProperties: CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN {} ELSE {rail: toInteger(m.rail)} END,
    relationshipType: CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE type(r) END
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]-(m:UndergroundStation)
WITH n.rail AS community,
     count(r) AS incident,
     sum(CASE WHEN m.rail <> n.rail THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS external
RETURN community, external, incident, toFloat(external)/incident AS conductance
ORDER BY community

raw_results.question: Run modularity optimization with one iteration, using rail as the seed property, and return the community of Redbridge station. Reply only with Redbridge:answer and nothing else.

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name:$name}) RETURN s.name AS name, s.rail AS rail, s.id AS id
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation) WHERE NOT (n)--() RETURN count(n) AS isolated

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: { rail: toInteger(n.rail) },
    targetNodeProperties: { rail: toInteger(m.rail) },
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
CALL gds.modularityOptimization.stream($graphName, {maxIterations: 1, seedProperty: 'rail'})
YIELD nodeId, communityId
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId) AS n, communityId
WHERE n.name = $name
RETURN n.name AS name, communityId

raw_results.question: Run the (k−1)-coloring algorithm for 20 iterations and report the number of colors required to color the graph. Reply strictly with colours:answer"

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {name: n.name},
    targetNodeProperties: {name: m.name},
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation),(b:UndergroundStation),(c:UndergroundStation),(d:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(a) < id(b) < id(c) < id(d)
  AND (a)-[:LINK]-(b)
  AND (a)-[:LINK]-(c)
  AND (a)-[:LINK]-(d)
  AND (b)-[:LINK]-(c)
  AND (b)-[:LINK]-(d)
  AND (c)-[:LINK]-(d)
RETURN [a.name,b.name,c.name,d.name] AS clique
LIMIT 5

raw_results.question: Run label propagation with one iteration, using rail as the seed property, and return the community of Kennington station. Reply only with Kennington:answer and nothing else.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: { rail: toInteger(n.rail) },
    targetNodeProperties: { rail: toInteger(m.rail) },
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:UndergroundStation {name:'Kennington'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (k)-[:LINK]-(n:UndergroundStation)
RETURN k.name AS name, k.rail AS seedRail, collect(DISTINCT {neighbor:n.name, rail:n.rail}) AS neighbors

raw_results.question: Run the SLLPA algorithm with one iteration and return the community of Kennington station. Reply only with Kennington:answer and nothing else. If the answer contains "[" or "]" remove them.

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'kennington' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'kennington' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id

CALL gds.sllpa.stream('tube_sllpa', {maxIterations: 1}) YIELD nodeId, communityIds
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId) AS n, communityIds
WHERE n.name = 'Kennington'
RETURN n.name AS name, communityIds

CALL gds.sllpa.stream('tube_sllpa', {maxIterations: 1}) YIELD nodeId, values
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId) AS n, values
WHERE n.name = 'Kennington'
RETURN n.name AS name, values.communityIds AS communityIds

raw_results.question: Run node similarity with cosine similarity and return the top eight most similar station pairs. Return each pair in the following format "station1 station2: similarity". Do not return anything else.

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name LIMIT 5

MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:LINK]-(nbr:UndergroundStation)
WITH s, collect(DISTINCT nbr) AS nbrs
WITH collect({name:s.name, id:id(s), nbrs:nbrs, deg:size(nbrs)}) AS stations
UNWIND stations AS a
UNWIND stations AS b
WITH a,b WHERE a.id < b.id AND a.deg > 0 AND b.deg > 0
WITH a,b, size([x IN a.nbrs WHERE x IN b.nbrs]) AS common
WITH a.name AS station1, b.name AS station2, common / sqrt(toFloat(a.deg*b.deg)) AS similarity
WHERE similarity > 0
RETURN station1, station2, similarity
ORDER BY similarity DESC, station1 ASC, station2 ASC
LIMIT 20

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WITH a.name AS a, b.name AS b, count(*) AS c
RETURN a,b,c LIMIT 10

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name:$source})
MATCH (t:UndergroundStation)
WHERE t.name IN $targets
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:LINK]-(sn:UndergroundStation)
WITH s,t, collect(DISTINCT sn.name) AS sNeighbors
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:LINK]-(tn:UndergroundStation)
WITH t.name AS station, sNeighbors, collect(DISTINCT tn.name) AS tNeighbors
WITH station, [x IN sNeighbors WHERE x IN tNeighbors] AS inter, sNeighbors + [x IN tNeighbors WHERE NOT x IN sNeighbors] AS union
RETURN station, toFloat(size(inter)) / size(union) AS similarity, inter, union
ORDER BY similarity DESC, station
LIMIT 4

raw_results.question: Run the Delta-Stepping shortest path algorithm from Covent Garden, using travel time as the relationship weight and setting delta=50. Response with all the paths and costs and nothing else in the example format. For example, the answer might be: ["Covent Garden", "X"]: [0.0, 2.0], ["Covent Garden", "A", "C"]: [0.0, 1.0, 2.0].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name:$name}) RETURN s.name AS name, s.id AS id, s.display_name AS display_name

MATCH (:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(:UndergroundStation) RETURN min(r.time) AS minTime, max(r.time) AS maxTime, count(r) AS rels, count { MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation) WHERE NOT (b)-[:LINK]->(a) } AS asymmetricPairs

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN [] ELSE labels(m) END,
    sourceNodeProperties: {},
    targetNodeProperties: {},
    relationshipType: type(r),
    relationshipProperties: {time: toFloat(r.time)}
  }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name:'Covent Garden'})
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.delta.stream('delta_covent_time', {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty: 'time', delta: 50})
YIELD index, sourceNode, targetNode, totalCost, nodeIds, costs
RETURN count(*) AS rows, min(totalCost) AS minCost, max(totalCost) AS maxCost

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name:'Covent Garden'})
CALL {
  WITH source
  CALL gds.allShortestPaths.delta.stream('delta_covent_time', {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty: 'time', delta: 50})
  YIELD targetNode, totalCost
  RETURN gds.util.asNode(targetNode).name AS name, totalCost AS deltaCost
}
WITH source, collect({name:name, cost:deltaCost}) AS deltaRows
CALL {
  WITH source
  CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream('delta_covent_time', {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
  YIELD targetNode, totalCost
  RETURN gds.util.asNode(targetNode).name AS name, totalCost AS dijkstraCost
}
WITH deltaRows, collect({name:name, cost:dijkstraCost}) AS dijkstraRows
UNWIND deltaRows AS d
WITH d, [x IN dijkstraRows WHERE x.name = d.name][0] AS dj
RETURN count(*) AS compared, sum(CASE WHEN dj IS NULL OR d.cost <> dj.cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches, collect(CASE WHEN dj IS NULL OR d.cost <> dj.cost THEN {name:d.name, delta:d.cost, dijkstra: dj.cost} ELSE null END)[0..10] AS sampleMismatches

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name:'Covent Garden'})
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.delta.stream('delta_covent_time', {sourceNode: source, relationshipWeightProperty: 'time', delta: 50})
YIELD targetNode, nodeIds, costs
WITH gds.util.asNode(targetNode).name AS targetName, [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS names, costs
ORDER BY targetName
WITH collect('[' + reduce(s='', x IN names | s + CASE WHEN s='' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + '"' + replace(x, '"', '\\"') + '"') + ']: [' + reduce(s='', c IN costs | s + CASE WHEN s='' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + toString(c)) + ']') AS lines
RETURN size(lines) AS count, reduce(s='', line IN lines | s + CASE WHEN s='' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + line) AS output

raw_results.question: Run the Dijkstra shortest path algorithm from Barons Court to South Kensington. I want the answer to be in the format of the path and the costs. For example, ["Barons Court", "X", "Y", "South Kensington"]: [0.0, 3.0, 4.5, 9.9].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s.name IN ['Barons Court','South Kensington'] RETURN s.name AS name, s.id AS id, s.display_name AS display_name

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]-(b:UndergroundStation) WHERE a.name IN ['Barons Court','South Kensington'] RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b, r.line AS line, r.time AS time, r.distance AS distance ORDER BY a.name,b.name,line

MATCH p = (start:UndergroundStation {name:$start})-[:LINK*1..6]->(end:UndergroundStation {name:$end})
WITH p, reduce(cost = 0.0, r IN relationships(p) | cost + toFloat(r.distance)) AS cost
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS path, cost
ORDER BY cost ASC, length(p) ASC
LIMIT 10

MATCH (a:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE (a.name = 'Barons Court' AND b.name = "Earl's Court")
   OR (a.name = "Earl's Court" AND b.name = 'Gloucester Road')
   OR (a.name = 'Gloucester Road' AND b.name = 'South Kensington')
RETURN a.name AS from, b.name AS to, collect(DISTINCT {line:r.line, distance:r.distance, time:r.time}) AS links
ORDER BY from, to

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {name: n.name},
    targetNodeProperties: {name: m.name},
    relationshipType: type(r),
    relationshipProperties: {distance: toFloat(r.distance)}
  }
)

MATCH (source:UndergroundStation {name:'Arsenal'})
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream('arsenal_dijkstra_graph', {
  sourceNode: source,
  relationshipWeightProperty: 'distance'
})
YIELD targetNode, totalCost, nodeIds, costs
RETURN gds.util.asNode(targetNode).name AS target,
       totalCost,
       [nodeId IN nodeIds | gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name] AS path,

raw_results.question: Run Yen’s algorithm with time as the relationship weight to find the 3 shortest paths from Bank to Waterloo. Format the results as path: costs, for example, ["A", "B", "C"]: [0.0, 98.7, 100.1], ["A", "E", "C"]: [0.0, 32.5, 150.0].

parameters.query:
MATCH p=(s:UndergroundStation {name:$source})-[:LINK*1..9]->(t:UndergroundStation {name:$target})
WITH p, relationships(p) AS rels, nodes(p) AS ns
WITH p, [n IN ns | n.name] AS path,
     reduce(total = 0.0, r IN rels | total + toFloat(r.time)) AS totalCost,
     rels
ORDER BY totalCost ASC
LIMIT 10
WITH path, totalCost,
     reduce(acc = [0.0], r IN rels | acc + [last(acc) + toFloat(r.time)]) AS costs
RETURN path, costs, totalCost

MATCH p=(s:UndergroundStation {name:$source})-[:LINK*1..9]->(t:UndergroundStation {name:$target})

raw_results.question: Compute the minimum directed Steiner tree starting from Bank and spanning the terminals Waterloo, Southwark, and Westminster. I want the output to be in the format of a sequence of [node, parent, weight]. For example: ["A", "B", 2.0], ["A", "C", 3.0], ["K", "L", 9.5].

parameters.query: MATCH (n:UndergroundStation) WHERE n.name IN ['Bank','Waterloo','Southwark','Westminster'] RETURN n.name AS name, n.id AS id, n.display_name AS display_name ORDER BY name
MATCH (b:UndergroundStation {name:'Bank'})-[r:LINK]->(m) RETURN b.name AS source, m.name AS target, r.distance AS distance, r.time AS time, r.line AS line ORDER BY target, line LIMIT 20

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {name: n.name},
    targetNodeProperties: {name: m.name},
    relationshipType: type(r),
    relationshipProperties: {distance: toFloat(r.distance)}
  }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name:'Bank'}),
      (tw:UndergroundStation {name:'Waterloo'}),
      (ts:UndergroundStation {name:'Southwark'}),
      (twe:UndergroundStation {name:'Westminster'})
MATCH pW=(s)-[:LINK*1..7]->(tw)
WHERE all(n IN nodes(pW) WHERE single(m IN nodes(pW) WHERE m = n))
  AND reduce(w=0.0, r IN relationships(pW) | w + toFloat(r.distance)) <= 7.0
WITH s, ts, twe, collect(pW) AS pathsW
MATCH pS=(s)-[:LINK*1..7]->(ts)
WHERE all(n IN nodes(pS) WHERE single(m IN nodes(pS) WHERE m = n))
  AND reduce(w=0.0, r IN relationships(pS) | w + toFloat(r.distance)) <= 7.0
WITH s, twe, pathsW, collect(pS) AS pathsS
MATCH pWe=(s)-[:LINK*1..7]->(twe)
WHERE all(n IN nodes(pWe) WHERE single(m IN nodes(pWe) WHERE m = n))
  AND reduce(w=0.0, r IN relationships(pWe) | w + toFloat(r.distance)) <= 7.0
WITH pathsW, pathsS, collect(pWe) AS pathsWe
UNWIND pathsW AS pW
UNWIND pathsS AS pS
UNWIND pathsWe AS pWe
WITH pW, pS, pWe, relationships(pW)+relationships(pS)+relationships(pWe) AS rels
WITH pW, pS, pWe, reduce(ids=[], r IN rels | CASE WHEN elementId(r) IN ids THEN ids ELSE ids + elementId(r) END) AS uniqueRelIds, rels
WITH pW, pS, pWe, uniqueRelIds, [id IN uniqueRelIds | [r IN rels WHERE elementId(r)=id][0]] AS uniqueRels
WITH pW, pS, pWe, uniqueRels, reduce(total=0.0, r IN uniqueRels | total + toFloat(r.distance)) AS unionWeight
RETURN unionWeight,
       [r IN uniqueRels | [startNode(r).name, endNode(r).name, toFloat(r.distance)]] AS edges,
       [n IN nodes(pW) | n.name] AS pathToWaterloo,
       [n IN nodes(pS) | n.name] AS pathToSouthwark,
       [n IN nodes(pWe) | n.name] AS pathToWestminster
ORDER BY unionWeight ASC
LIMIT 5

raw_results.question: Compute the prize-collecting Steiner tree on the database graph, using distance as the relationship weight and zone as the node prize. Format the results as a sequence of [node, parent, weight]. For example: ["A", "B", 2.0], ["A", "C", 3.0], ["K", "L", 9.5].

parameters.query:
CALL gds.prizeSteinerTree.stream('pcst_tube', {relationshipWeightProperty:'distance', prizeProperty:'zone'})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
RETURN gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name AS node, gds.util.asNode(parentId).name AS parent, weight
ORDER BY node
LIMIT 5

CALL gds.prizeSteinerTree.stream('pcst_tube', {relationshipWeightProperty:'distance', prizeProperty:'zone'})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name AS node, gds.util.asNode(parentId).name AS parent, weight
RETURN count(*) AS edgeCount, sum(weight) AS totalWeight,
       collect([node, parent, weight]) AS result

CALL gds.prizeSteinerTree.stream('pcst_tube', {relationshipWeightProperty:'distance', prizeProperty:'zone'})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
WITH collect({node:gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name, parent:gds.util.asNode(parentId).name, weight:weight}) AS edges, sum(weight) AS gdsTotal, count(*) AS edgeCount
UNWIND edges AS e
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation {name:e.node}), (p:UndergroundStation {name:e.parent})
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r1:LINK]->(p)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r2:LINK]->(n)
WITH edgeCount, gdsTotal, e, coalesce(r1.distance, r2.distance) AS dbDistance
RETURN edgeCount, gdsTotal,
       sum(toFloat(dbDistance)) AS dbTotal,
       count(CASE WHEN dbDistance IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missingEdges,
       count(CASE WHEN toFloat(dbDistance) <> e.weight THEN 1 END) AS weightMismatches

CALL gds.prizeSteinerTree.stream('pcst_tube', {relationshipWeightProperty:'distance', prizeProperty:'zone'})
YIELD nodeId, parentId, weight
WITH collect({node:gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name, parent:gds.util.asNode(parentId).name, weight:weight}) AS edges
UNWIND edges AS e
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation {name:e.node}), (p:UndergroundStation {name:e.parent})
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]-(p)
WITH e, min(toFloat(r.distance)) AS dbDistance
RETURN count(*) AS edgeCount, sum(e.weight) AS gdsTotal, sum(dbDistance) AS dbMinDistanceTotal,
       count(CASE WHEN dbDistance IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missingEdges,
       count(CASE WHEN dbDistance <> e.weight THEN 1 END) AS minDistanceMismatches,
       collect(CASE WHEN dbDistance <> e.weight THEN [e.node,e.parent,e.weight,dbDistance] END)[0..10] AS exampleMismatches

raw_results.question: Run the all-pairs shortest paths algorithm on the entire graph, using time as the relationship weight. Format the output result as a sequence of [source, target, distance]. For example, ["A", "B", 20.5], ["A", "Z", 21.0].

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {name: n.name},
    targetNodeProperties: {name: m.name},
    relationshipType: type(r),
    relationshipProperties: {time: toFloat(r.time)}
  }
)

parameters.query:
CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream('apsp_time_entire_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD sourceNodeId, targetNodeId, distance
RETURN count(*) AS pathCount, min(distance) AS minDistance, max(distance) AS maxDistance

CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream('apsp_time_entire_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD sourceNodeId, targetNodeId, distance
WITH gds.util.asNode(sourceNodeId).name AS source, gds.util.asNode(targetNodeId).name AS target, distance
RETURN [source, target, distance] AS triplet
ORDER BY source, target
LIMIT 500

CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream('apsp_time_entire_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD *
RETURN *
LIMIT 1

CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream('apsp_time_entire_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
RETURN *
LIMIT 1

SHOW PROCEDURES YIELD name, signature
WHERE name = 'gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream'
RETURN name, signature

CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream('apsp_time_entire_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD sourceNode, targetNode, totalCost
RETURN count(*) AS pathCount, min(totalCost) AS minDistance, max(totalCost) AS maxDistance

CALL gds.allShortestPaths.dijkstra.stream('apsp_time_entire_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD sourceNode, targetNode, totalCost
WITH gds.util.asNode(sourceNode).name AS source, gds.util.asNode(targetNode).name AS target, totalCost AS distance
RETURN [source, target, distance] AS triplet
ORDER BY source, target
LIMIT 500

SHOW PROCEDURES YIELD name, signature
WHERE name CONTAINS 'allShortestPaths'
RETURN name, signature
ORDER BY name

CALL gds.allShortestPaths.stream('apsp_time_entire_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD sourceNodeId, targetNodeId, distance
RETURN count(*) AS pathCount, min(distance) AS minDistance, max(distance) AS maxDistance

CALL gds.allShortestPaths.stream('apsp_time_entire_graph', {relationshipWeightProperty: 'time'})
YIELD sourceNodeId, targetNodeId, distance
WITH gds.util.asNode(sourceNodeId).name AS source, gds.util.asNode(targetNodeId).name AS target, distance
RETURN [source, target, distance] AS triplet

raw_results.question: What are some of the fastest options to travel from Paddington to London Bridge? Format the results as path: costs, for example, ["A", "B", "C"]: [0.0, 98.7, 100.1], ["A", "E", "C"]: [0.0, 32.5, 150.0].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'paddington' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'paddington' OR toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'london bridge' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'london bridge' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id ORDER BY name

MATCH p = (src:UndergroundStation {name:'Paddington'})-[:LINK*1..12]->(dst:UndergroundStation {name:'London Bridge'})
WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE single(m IN nodes(p) WHERE id(m)=id(n)))
WITH [n IN nodes(p) | n.name] AS path, relationships(p) AS rels
WITH path,
     [i IN range(0, size(rels)) | reduce(total = 0.0, r IN rels[0..i] | total + toFloat(r.time))] AS costs,
     reduce(total = 0.0, r IN rels | total + toFloat(r.time)) AS totalCost,
     [r IN rels | r.line] AS lines
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, size(path) ASC, path ASC
WITH path, min(totalCost) AS totalCost, collect(costs)[0] AS costs, collect(lines)[0] AS lines
RETURN path, costs, totalCost, lines
ORDER BY totalCost ASC, size(path) ASC, path ASC
LIMIT 15

raw_results.question: Tell me whether King’s Cross St. Pancras or Angel counts as the more important station, if importance means appearing on lots of shortest routes between stations. Tell me the station that is the answer and nothing else.

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'king' OR toLower(s.name) = 'angel' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'king' OR toLower(s.display_name)='angel' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id ORDER BY name

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {name: n.name},
    targetNodeProperties: {name: m.name},
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (c:UndergroundStation)
WHERE c.name IN ["King's Cross St. Pancras", 'Angel']
WITH collect(c) AS candidates
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation), (t:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(s) < id(t)
MATCH p = allShortestPaths((s)-[:LINK*]-(t))
UNWIND nodes(p)[1..-1] AS n
WITH n, candidates
WHERE n IN candidates
RETURN n.name AS station, count(*) AS shortest_paths_through
ORDER BY shortest_paths_through DESC

MATCH (c:UndergroundStation)
WHERE c.name IN ["King's Cross St. Pancras", 'Angel']
WITH collect(c) AS candidates
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation), (t:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(s) < id(t)
MATCH p = shortestPath((s)-[:LINK*]-(t))
UNWIND candidates AS c
WITH c, p
WHERE c IN nodes(p)[1..-1]
RETURN c.name AS station, count(*) AS sampled_shortest_paths_through
ORDER BY sampled_shortest_paths_through DESC

raw_results.question: What are the stations that can’t be reached starting from Canary Wharf? List such stops in the format of ["A", "B", "C"].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'canary' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'canary' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.id AS id
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation {name:$name}) RETURN s.name AS name, [(s)-[r:LINK]->(m) | {to:m.name,line:r.line}] AS outgoing, [(m)-[r:LINK]->(s) | {from:m.name,line:r.line}] AS incoming

MATCH (start:UndergroundStation {name:$startName})
MATCH (st:UndergroundStation)
WHERE NOT (start)-[:LINK*0..]->(st)
RETURN collect(st.name) AS unreachable, count(st) AS count

WITH st, p
WHERE p IS NULL
RETURN collect(st.name) AS unreachable, count(st) AS count

OPTIONAL MATCH p = shortestPath((start)-[:LINK*..302]->(st))
WITH st, p
WHERE p IS NULL

raw_results.question: Which stations, if shut down, would leave more stations cut off from each other? List such stops in the format of ["A", "B", "C"].

parameters.query:
MATCH (v:UndergroundStation)
MATCH (v)--(a:UndergroundStation)
MATCH (v)--(b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH p = (a)-[:LINK*]-(b)
    WHERE none(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n = v)
  }
RETURN v.name AS station
ORDER BY station
CALL apoc.help('path.subgraphNodes') YIELD name RETURN name LIMIT 5

CALL gds.articulationPoints.stream('underground_undirected') YIELD nodeId
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name AS station
ORDER BY station
RETURN collect(station) AS stations, count(*) AS count

CALL gds.biconnectedComponents.stream('underground_undirected') YIELD nodeId, componentId
WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId).name AS station, count(DISTINCT componentId) AS components
WHERE components > 1
RETURN count(*) AS count, collect(station)[0..5] AS sample

SHOW PROCEDURES YIELD name
WHERE name CONTAINS 'biconnect' OR name CONTAINS 'articulation'
RETURN name
ORDER BY name

raw_results.question: What are the five stations located nearest to Paddington? List the station names in the format ["A", "B", "C"].

parameters.query: MATCH (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'paddington' OR toLower(s.display_name) CONTAINS 'paddington' RETURN s.name AS name, s.display_name AS display_name, s.latitude AS lat, s.longitude AS lon, s.id AS id

MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name:'Paddington'}), (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s <> p WITH s, point.distance(point({latitude:p.latitude, longitude:p.longitude}), point({latitude:s.latitude, longitude:s.longitude})) AS distanceMeters RETURN s.name AS name, distanceMeters ORDER BY distanceMeters ASC LIMIT 5

MATCH (p:UndergroundStation {name:'Paddington'}), (s:UndergroundStation) WHERE s <> p WITH s, 6371000 * 2 * asin(sqrt( sin(radians((s.latitude - p.latitude)/2))^2 + cos(radians(p.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * sin(radians((s.longitude - p.longitude)/2))^2 )) AS distanceMeters RETURN s.name AS name, distanceMeters ORDER BY distanceMeters ASC LIMIT 5

raw_results.question: Can I travel between every pair of stations in this transport network? Answer Yes or No and nothing else.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    relationshipType: type(r)
  }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (a:UndergroundStation), (b:UndergroundStation)
WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  AND (NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[:LINK*]->(b) } OR NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[:LINK*]->(a) })
RETURN count(*) AS nonMutuallyReachablePairs

parameters.cypher_query:

)

raw_results.question: If every link between two stations works both ways, can I reach any station from any other in this network?  Answer Yes or No and nothing else.

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (n:UndergroundStation)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:LINK]->(m:UndergroundStation)
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  n,
  m,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(n),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(m),
    sourceNodeProperties: {id: n.id, name: n.name},
    targetNodeProperties: {id: m.id, name: m.name},
    relationshipType: type(r)
  },
  { undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['LINK'] }
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (s:UndergroundStation)
WITH count(s) AS total
MATCH (start:UndergroundStation)
WITH total, start LIMIT 1
MATCH (start)-[:LINK*0..]-(reachable:UndergroundStation)
RETURN total, count(DISTINCT reachable) AS reachableCount, count(DISTINCT reachable) = total AS connected
